mapper.sql: emp43_eval_target_id AS eval_target_id, emp43_company_id AS company_id, emp43_person_id AS person_id, emp43_std_year AS std_year, emp43_std_term_cd AS std_term_cd, emp43_eval_list_std_id AS eval_list_std_id, emp43_eval_start_date AS eval_start_date, emp43_eval_close_date AS eval_close_date, emp43_org_head_nm AS org_head_nm, emp43_pos_nm AS pos_nm, emp43_person_nm AS person_nm, emp43_org_nm AS org_nm, emp43_first_evaluator_id AS first_evaluator_id, emp43_first_org_nm AS first_org_nm, emp43_first_person_nm AS first_person_nm, emp43_first_eval_weight AS first_eval_weight, emp43_second_evaluator_id AS second_evaluator_id, emp43_second_org_nm AS second_org_nm, emp43_second_person_nm AS second_person_nm, emp43_second_eval_weight AS second_eval_weight, emp43_sum_eval_weight AS sum_eval_weight, emp43_status AS status

SELECT * , f_cdnm('EmpEvalTermCode', emp43_std_term_cd, emp43_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp43_std_term_nm , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp03_org_head_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '조직장' ELSE '조직원' END FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp43_person_id AND emp03_trans_date IN ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp43_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= (emp43_std_year||'-12-31')::date ) ) AS emp43_org_head_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp43_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS emp43_pos_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp43_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'title_nm') AS emp43_title_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(emp43_person_id) AS emp43_person_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp43_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp43_org_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(emp43_first_evaluator_id) AS emp43_first_person_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp43_first_evaluator_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp43_first_org_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(emp43_second_evaluator_id) AS emp43_second_person_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp43_second_evaluator_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp43_second_org_nm , (COALESCE(emp43_first_eval_weight,0)+COALESCE(emp43_second_eval_weight,0)) AS emp43_sum_eval_weight , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp44_eval_write WHERE emp43_eval_target_id = emp44_eval_target_id ) THEN '진행중' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr01_appr LEFT JOIN emp45_eval_relate_appr ON emp45_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp45_std_year = emp43_std_year AND emp45_std_term_cd = emp43_std_term_cd AND emp45_company_id = emp43_company_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '') IN ('10','20') ) THEN '상신중' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr01_appr LEFT JOIN emp45_eval_relate_appr ON emp45_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp45_std_year = emp43_std_year AND emp45_std_term_cd = emp43_std_term_cd AND emp45_company_id = emp43_company_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '') = '30' ) THEN '완료' ELSE '' END AS emp43_status FROM emp43_eval_target
mapper.select: SELECT sys01_emp_eval_cycle_cd AS emp_eval_cycle_code, sys01_emp_eval_month_cd AS emp_eval_month_code FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp43_eval_target (emp43_eval_target_id, emp43_company_id, emp43_person_id, emp43_std_year, emp43_eval_list_std_id, emp43_std_term_cd, emp43_eval_start_date, emp43_eval_close_date, emp43_first_evaluator_id, emp43_first_eval_weight, emp43_second_evaluator_id, emp43_second_eval_weight) VALUES (#{row.evalTargetId}, #{companyId}, #{row.personId}, #{row.stdYear}, #{row.evalListStdId}, #{row.stdTermCd}, #{row.evalStartDate}, #{row.evalCloseDate}, #{row.firstEvaluatorId}, #{row.firstEvalWeight}, #{row.secondEvaluatorId}, #{row.secondEvalWeight})
mapper.sql: WITH emp00 AS ( SELECT t2.emp03_trans_id AS emp00_trans_id, t2.emp03_trans_date AS emp00_trans_date, t2.emp03_person_id AS emp00_person_id, t2.emp03_trans_cd AS emp00_trans_cd, t2.emp03_title_cd AS emp00_title_cd, t2.emp03_pos_cd AS emp00_pos_cd, t2.emp03_org_code_id AS emp00_org_code_id, f_org_nm(t2.emp03_org_code_id, t2.emp03_trans_date) AS emp00_org_title_nm, t2.emp03_org_head_yn AS emp00_org_head_yn FROM emp01_person t1 INNER JOIN emp03_trans t2 ON t2.emp03_person_id = t1.emp01_person_id WHERE t1.emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND t2.emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = t1.emp01_person_id AND ( (x.emp03_trans_cd = '900' AND to_char(x.emp03_trans_date,'yyyymmdd') < replace(#{transDate},'-','')) OR (x.emp03_trans_cd != '900' AND to_char(x.emp03_trans_date,'yyyymmdd') <= replace(#{transDate},'-',''))) ) AND 'Y' = (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = t1.emp01_person_id) = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp01_person a INNER JOIN emp04_add_title ON emp04_person_id = a.emp01_person_id WHERE emp04_add_person_id = t1.emp01_person_id) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) END) ), org00 AS ( SELECT org01_code_id AS org00_org_code_id, org01_org_cd AS org00_org_cd, org02_kor_nm AS org00_kor_nm, org02_mod_date AS org00_mod_date FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} )
mapper.select: SELECT emp00_person_id AS person_id, emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id, emp00_org_title_nm AS org_title_nm, f_org_parent_full_nm(emp00_org_code_id, emp00_trans_date) AS parent_full_nm, f_get_empTrans(emp00_person_id, emp00_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_nm, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS pos_nm, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp00_org_head_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '조직장' ELSE '조직원' END AS org_head_nm, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, emp00_trans_date AS trans_date FROM emp00 trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp00_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp00_trans_cd <= '799' AND ( (emp01_kor_nm || org00_kor_nm || emp01_emp_no) LIKE #{searchText} OR ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp00_org_head_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '조직장' ELSE '조직원' END ) LIKE #{searchText} ) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp00_trans_date ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) ) ORDER BY org00_org_cd, emp00_title_cd, emp00_pos_cd, emp01_order_seq

SELECT person_id, org_title_nm, kor_nm FROM ( SELECT emp00_person_id AS person_id, emp00_org_title_nm AS org_title_nm, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, '1' AS level FROM emp00 INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp00_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE COALESCE(emp00_org_head_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND emp00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND #{personId} NOT IN ( SELECT emp00_person_id FROM emp00 WHERE emp00_org_head_yn = 'true' AND emp00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} ) UNION ALL SELECT emp00_person_id, emp00_org_title_nm, emp01_kor_nm, '2' AS level FROM emp00 INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp00_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE COALESCE(emp00_org_head_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND emp00_org_code_id = ( SELECT org02_parent_code_id FROM org02_info INNER JOIN org01_code ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND org02_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN org01_open_date AND COALESCE(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyymmdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = org02_info.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) ) UNION ALL SELECT emp00_person_id, emp00_org_title_nm, emp01_kor_nm, '3' AS level FROM emp00 INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp00_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id WHERE COALESCE(emp00_org_head_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND emp00_org_code_id = ( SELECT org02_parent_code_id FROM org02_info INNER JOIN org01_code ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND org02_code_id = ( SELECT org02_parent_code_id FROM org02_info INNER JOIN org01_code ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND org02_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN org01_open_date AND COALESCE(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyymmdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = org02_info.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) ) AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN org01_open_date AND COALESCE(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyymmdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = org02_info.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) ) ) AS result ORDER BY level

SELECT CASE WHEN emp43_first_evaluator_id = #{personId} THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp43_first_eval_end_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '완료' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(emp44_eval_write_id) FROM emp44_eval_write WHERE emp43_eval_target_id = emp44_eval_target_id AND emp44_evaluator_id = #{personId} ) > 0 THEN '작성중' ELSE '' END ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp43_second_eval_end_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '완료' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(emp44_eval_write_id) FROM emp44_eval_write WHERE emp43_eval_target_id = emp44_eval_target_id AND emp44_evaluator_id = #{personId} ) > 0 THEN '작성중' ELSE '' END END FROM emp43_eval_target WHERE emp43_eval_target_id = #{evalTargetId} AND emp43_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT emp45_eval_relate_appr_id AS eval_relate_appr_id, emp45_appr_id AS appr_id, emp45_final_appr_id AS final_appr_id, a.apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, b.apr01_status_cd AS final_appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', a.apr01_status_cd, emp45_company_id, a.apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, emp45_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS final_appr_status_name FROM emp45_eval_relate_appr LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr a ON a.apr01_appr_id = emp45_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = emp45_final_appr_id WHERE emp45_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp45_std_year = #{stdYear} AND emp45_std_term_cd = #{stdTermCode}
